title.en: Unit 2 Notes — Quantity and Quality of Water
title.gu: યુનિટ 2 Notes — Water ની Quantity અને Quality

body.en:
Population forecasting estimates future service demand for a chosen design period. Use consistent census boundaries and consider migration, industrial growth, housing, planning and uncertain changes.

Methods:

  • Arithmetic increase: add the average absolute increase per decade for each future decade; suitable as a simple approximation for relatively stable absolute growth.
  • Geometric increase: compound the average percentage growth per decade; appropriate only if a roughly constant growth rate is reasonable.
  • Incremental increase: include the average change in decadal increase as well as the average increase; sensitive to short or irregular records.
  • Other methods: graphical comparison or logistic/saturation models may reflect planning and constraints but require appropriate assumptions and data.

Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees. Compare methods and check whether the trend is plausible for the particular town.
body.gu:
Population forecasting પસંદ કરેલા design period માટે future service demand નો અંદાજ આપે છે. Census boundaries સુસંગત રાખી migration, industrial growth, housing, planning અને અનિશ્ચિત ફેરફારો ધ્યાનમાં લો.

પદ્ધતિઓ:

  • Arithmetic increase: દરેક future decade માટે સરેરાશ absolute decadal increase ઉમેરો; લગભગ સ્થિર absolute growth માટે સરળ અંદાજ છે.
  • Geometric increase: સરેરાશ percentage growth ને દરેક decade માટે compound કરો; લગભગ સ્થિર growth rate યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે જ વાપરો.
  • Incremental increase: સરેરાશ increase સાથે decadal increase માં સરેરાશ ફેરફાર પણ લો; ટૂંકા અથવા અનિયમિત records પ્રત્યે સંવેદનશીલ છે.
  • અન્ય પદ્ધતિઓ: graphical comparison અથવા logistic/saturation models માં planning અને limits સમાવી શકાય, પરંતુ યોગ્ય assumptions અને data જરૂરી છે.

Forecasts અંદાજ છે, ખાતરી નથી. પદ્ધતિઓ સરખાવી ચોક્કસ town માટે trend શક્ય છે કે નહીં તપાસો.

body.en:
Demand components:

  • Domestic: drinking, cooking, bathing, washing and sanitation.
  • Institutional, commercial and industrial: schools, hospitals, businesses and suitable industries.
  • Public use and fire demand: parks, street washing and emergency firefighting as specified.
  • Losses and non-revenue water: leakage, unauthorised use and metering errors; distinguish actual losses from apparent losses.

Average daily domestic demand = population × per-capita consumption, with units checked. Add other demands and losses only if they are not already included in the selected per-capita allowance. Demand varies by season, day and hour; intake, treatment, storage, pumps and mains may be designed for different peak conditions. Peaking factors are project assumptions or code guidance, not universal constants.

Demand factors: climate, living standard, tariffs and metering, supply pressure and continuity, population, water quality, sewerage, industrial activity and conservation behaviour.
body.gu:
Demand components:

  • Domestic: પીવું, રસોઈ, સ્નાન, ધોવું અને sanitation.
  • Institutional, commercial અને industrial: schools, hospitals, businesses અને યોગ્ય industries.
  • Public use અને fire demand: parks, street washing અને નિર્દિષ્ટ emergency firefighting.
  • Losses અને non-revenue water: leakage, unauthorised use અને metering errors; actual losses અને apparent losses અલગ ઓળખો.

Average daily domestic demand = population × per-capita consumption, યોગ્ય units સાથે. પસંદ કરેલા per-capita allowance માં અન્ય demands અને losses પહેલેથી હોય તો ફરી ન ઉમેરો. Demand season, day અને hour પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે; intake, treatment, storage, pumps અને mains માટે જુદી peak conditions હોઈ શકે. Peaking factors project assumptions અથવા code guidance છે, સાર્વત્રિક constants નથી.

Demand ને અસર કરતા factors: climate, living standard, tariffs અને metering, supply pressure અને continuity, population, water quality, sewerage, industrial activity અને conservation behaviour.

body.en:
Classes of impurities:

  • Suspended: silt, clay and organic particles cause turbidity and interfere with disinfection.
  • Colloidal: very fine stable particles may need coagulation before settling and filtration.
  • Dissolved: salts, hardness, fluoride, nitrate, iron and gases can affect health, taste, scaling or corrosion depending on concentration.
  • Biological: bacteria, viruses, protozoa and algae; some are disease-causing or create taste and odour.

TDS is only a combined indicator of dissolved matter; it cannot identify pathogens or specific toxic chemicals. Test according to the source risks.
body.gu:
Impurities ના પ્રકારો:

  • Suspended: silt, clay અને organic particles turbidity વધારી disinfection માં અડચણ કરે છે.
  • Colloidal: અત્યંત સૂક્ષ્મ સ્થિર particles માટે settling અને filtration પહેલાં coagulation જરૂરી હોઈ શકે.
  • Dissolved: salts, hardness, fluoride, nitrate, iron અને gases concentration મુજબ health, taste, scaling અથવા corrosion ને અસર કરે છે.
  • Biological: bacteria, viruses, protozoa અને algae; કેટલાક રોગ પેદા કરે અથવા taste અને odour બદલાવે છે.

TDS ફક્ત dissolved matter નું એકત્ર સૂચક છે; તે pathogens અથવા ચોક્કસ toxic chemicals ઓળખી શકતું નથી. Source risks પ્રમાણે tests કરો.

body.en:
Representative sampling:

  1. Select locations and times appropriate to the purpose; record date, source, location, conditions and collector.
  2. Use the laboratory-prescribed clean container for chemical tests and sterile container for microbiological tests. Chlorinated water for microbiology commonly requires a pre-dosed sterile sodium-thiosulfate bottle supplied by the laboratory.
  3. Prevent contamination, preserve and cool as specified, deliver promptly and maintain chain of custody. Do not rinse a pre-treated microbiological bottle.
  4. Measure unstable parameters such as residual chlorine at site when required by the method.

Tests: physical tests include temperature, colour and nephelometric turbidity (NTU); chemical tests include pH, TDS, hardness by EDTA titration, fluoride, nitrate and residual chlorine by validated methods; microbiological tests include E. coli or coliform testing using a validated laboratory method. Follow method-specific sampling and holding times.
body.gu:
Representative sampling:

  1. હેતુ પ્રમાણે locations અને times પસંદ કરો; date, source, location, conditions અને collector નોંધો.
  2. Chemical tests માટે laboratory-prescribed clean container અને microbiological tests માટે sterile container લો. Chlorinated water ની microbiology માટે સામાન્ય રીતે laboratory દ્વારા આપવામાં આવેલી pre-dosed sterile sodium-thiosulfate bottle જરૂરી છે.
  3. Contamination ટાળો, સૂચના મુજબ preserve અને cool કરો, ઝડપથી પહોંચાડો તથા chain of custody જાળવો. Pre-treated microbiological bottle ધોઈ ન નાખો.
  4. પદ્ધતિમાં જરૂરી હોય ત્યારે residual chlorine જેવા unstable parameters site પર માપો.

Tests: physical tests માં temperature, colour અને nephelometric turbidity (NTU); chemical tests માં pH, TDS, EDTA titration દ્વારા hardness, fluoride, nitrate અને validated methods દ્વારા residual chlorine; microbiological tests માં validated laboratory method થી E. coli અથવા coliform testing આવે છે. Method-specific sampling અને holding times અનુસરો.

body.en:
IS 10500 specifies drinking-water quality requirements. An acceptable limit is the preferred quality; for some parameters a higher permissible value applies only in the absence of an alternative source and subject to the standard. It is not a routine target. Verify the current edition, amendments and local requirements.

Common teaching values from IS 10500:2012, subject to current verification:

  • Turbidity: acceptable 1 NTU; permissible 5 NTU when applicable.
  • pH: acceptable 6.5–8.5, no relaxation.
  • Total dissolved solids: acceptable 500 mg/L; permissible 2000 mg/L when applicable.
  • Fluoride: acceptable 1.0 mg/L; permissible 1.5 mg/L when applicable.
  • Nitrate: 45 mg/L as nitrate, no relaxation.
  • E. coli or thermotolerant coliform: absent in 100 mL; follow standard sampling and compliance provisions.

Compliance depends on the full relevant parameter set, not one measurement. Contact the water authority if faecal contamination is suspected.
body.gu:
IS 10500 drinking-water quality requirements નિર્દિષ્ટ કરે છે. Acceptable limit ઇચ્છનીય quality છે; અમુક parameters માટે alternative source ન હોય ત્યારે જ અને standard ની શરતો હેઠળ ઊંચી permissible value લાગુ પડે છે. તેને નિયમિત target ન માનો. Current edition, amendments અને local requirements તપાસો.

IS 10500:2012 ના સામાન્ય શૈક્ષણિક values, current verification હેઠળ:

  • Turbidity: acceptable 1 NTU; લાગુ હોય ત્યારે permissible 5 NTU.
  • pH: acceptable 6.5–8.5, relaxation નથી.
  • Total dissolved solids: acceptable 500 mg/L; લાગુ હોય ત્યારે permissible 2000 mg/L.
  • Fluoride: acceptable 1.0 mg/L; લાગુ હોય ત્યારે permissible 1.5 mg/L.
  • Nitrate: nitrate તરીકે 45 mg/L, relaxation નથી.
  • E. coli અથવા thermotolerant coliform: 100 mL માં absent; standard sampling અને compliance provisions અનુસરો.

Compliance સંબંધિત તમામ parameters પર આધારિત છે, એક measurement પર નહીં. Faecal contamination ની શંકા હોય તો water authority નો સંપર્ક કરો.

title.gu: Numerical 2.1 — Arithmetic population forecast ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: Census populations are 20,000, 24,000 and 29,000 at 10-year intervals. Forecast 20 years after the last census by arithmetic increase.

Step 1. Calculate decadal increases.

I1 = 24000 − 20000I1 = 4000I2 = 29000 − 24000I2 = 5000Average increase = (4000 + 5000) / 2Average increase = 4500 per decade

Step 2. Project for two decades.

Pfuture = Plast + n × average increasePfuture = 29000 + 2 × 4500

Final answer:

Forecast population = 38,000 persons.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 10-year intervals પર census populations 20,000, 24,000 અને 29,000 છે. છેલ્લી census પછી 20 વર્ષ માટે arithmetic increase થી forecast કરો.

Step 1. Decadal increases ગણો.

I1 = 24000 − 20000I1 = 4000I2 = 29000 − 24000I2 = 5000Average increase = (4000 + 5000) / 2Average increase = 4500 per decade

Step 2. બે decades માટે projection કરો.

Pfuture = Plast + n × average increasePfuture = 29000 + 2 × 4500

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Forecast population = 38,000 persons.

title.gu: Numerical 2.2 — Geometric population forecast ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: The current population is 50,000. Assume a constant growth rate of 10% per decade. Forecast after 20 years.

Step 1. Find the number of decades.

n = 20 / 10n = 2

Step 2. Apply compounding.

Pfuture = Plast(1 + r)ⁿPfuture = 50000 × (1 + 0.10)²Pfuture = 50000 × 1.21

Final answer:

Forecast population = 60,500 persons.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: વર્તમાન population 50,000 છે. દરેક decade માં 10% constant growth rate ધારો. 20 વર્ષ પછીનું forecast કરો.

Step 1. Decades ની સંખ્યા શોધો.

n = 20 / 10n = 2

Step 2. Compounding લાગુ કરો.

Pfuture = Plast(1 + r)ⁿPfuture = 50000 × (1 + 0.10)²Pfuture = 50000 × 1.21

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Forecast population = 60,500 persons.

title.en: Numerical 2.3 — Water demand and peak day
title.gu: Numerical 2.3 — Water demand અને peak day ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A population of 40,000 requires 135 L/person/day for domestic use. Add separate public demand of 0.30 MLD and 10% physical losses on the sum. Assume maximum-day factor 1.8.

Step 1. Calculate domestic demand.

Domestic demand = 40000 × 135Domestic demand = 5400000 L/dayDomestic demand = 5.40 MLD

Step 2. Add public demand and losses.

Subtotal = 5.40 + 0.30Subtotal = 5.70 MLDAverage production = 5.70 × 1.10Average production = 6.27 MLD

Step 3. Apply the assumed peak-day factor.

Maximum-day production = 6.27 × 1.8

Final answer:

Maximum-day production = 11.286 MLD under the stated assumptions.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 40,000 ની population માટે domestic use 135 L/person/day છે. અલગ public demand 0.30 MLD અને આ કુલ પર 10% physical losses ઉમેરો. Maximum-day factor 1.8 ધારો.

Step 1. Domestic demand ગણો.

Domestic demand = 40000 × 135Domestic demand = 5400000 L/dayDomestic demand = 5.40 MLD

Step 2. Public demand અને losses ઉમેરો.

Subtotal = 5.40 + 0.30Subtotal = 5.70 MLDAverage production = 5.70 × 1.10Average production = 6.27 MLD

Step 3. ધારેલ peak-day factor લાગુ કરો.

Maximum-day production = 6.27 × 1.8

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ assumptions હેઠળ maximum-day production = 11.286 MLD.

body.en:
Given: A 50 mL sample requires 12.0 mL EDTA. One mL EDTA is equivalent to 1.0 mg CaCO₃ under the stated standardisation. Calculate total hardness as CaCO₃.

Step 1. Calculate CaCO₃ equivalent in the sample.

CaCO₃ equivalent = 12.0 × 1.0CaCO₃ equivalent = 12.0 mg

Step 2. Convert to mg/L.

Hardness = 12.0 × 1000 / 50

Final answer:

Total hardness = 240 mg/L as CaCO₃.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: 50 mL sample માટે 12.0 mL EDTA જરૂરી છે. આપેલ standardisation મુજબ 1 mL EDTA = 1.0 mg CaCO₃ છે. Total hardness ને CaCO₃ તરીકે ગણો.

Step 1. Sample માં CaCO₃ equivalent ગણો.

CaCO₃ equivalent = 12.0 × 1.0CaCO₃ equivalent = 12.0 mg

Step 2. mg/L માં રૂપાંતર કરો.

Hardness = 12.0 × 1000 / 50

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Total hardness = 240 mg/L as CaCO₃.

title.en: Formulae, methods and key data — Unit 2
title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 2

body.en:
Use stated assumptions, units and the relevant test method.

Pfuture = Plast + n × average decadal increasePfuture = Plast(1 + r)ⁿAverage demand = population × per-capita demandPeak demand = average demand × assumed peak factorHardness (mg/L as CaCO₃) = EDTA volume × mg CaCO₃ per mL EDTA × 1000 / sample volume (mL)
